response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile engineer with a strong web/full-stack background (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang), but the role demands deep, current C++ expertise for industrial automation. His C++ experience is limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a thesis project, and he shows no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL practices, MQTT, message brokers at scale in C++, or industrial protocol experience. The core skill mismatch outweighs his general seniority.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience exceeding the 8–12 year range
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (millions of HTTP req/s at Dunnhumby using async I/O and fibers)
Strong engineering culture: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (brief role ending in 2015); primary stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang
No industrial cybersecurity, SDL, or IEC 62443 exposure; no MQTT or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)
No industrial automation or IoT domain background; recent work is web/SaaS product engineering
